text: mi klama .e to do .e pu bo .i do klama
reason: The KU rule requires written KU before BO. See grammars/lojban/experimental/syntax.md#deliberate-ku-omission-limits.
The listed bare tag cannot stand before the actual following selbri. Written KU or NUhU separates the term.
The retained CLL number-continuation query keeps the number and letter string together.
